howto.title: How to play?
howto.subtitle: Quick guide to playing and creating quests
howto.play1Text: Choose a quest and tap “Create game” — a game code appears
howto.play2Text: Participants enter the code on their phones and join the game
howto.play3Text: Click tiles on the board — everyone sees the question
howto.play4Text: Players tap the button on their phone. The first one answers, the rest wait
howto.play5Text: Mark “Correct” or “Wrong” — the score updates automatically
howto.create1Text: On the selection page, tap “New quest”
howto.create2Text: Enter a name and pick the grid size: categories × questions
howto.create3Text: Click tiles and add the question, answer and, if you like, a photo or audio
howto.create4Text: Everything saves automatically — come back and start the game

about.h1: About Quiz Quest — online party quiz
about.lead: A free team quiz with a game-show vibe: the host opens questions on a board while friends race from their phones. Ready-made movie and music packs, or your own board in minutes.
about.heroCaption: Board on the big screen · buzz-in on phones
about.whatText: Quiz Quest is a web quiz where one device shows a Jeopardy-style board with categories and points, and players join by code on smartphones. Whoever buzzes first answers out loud. The host marks correct or wrong and the score updates automatically. Perfect for parties without extra hardware.
about.audiencePartyText: Birthdays, movie nights, hangouts — start fast and everyone plays from their phones.
about.audienceFamilyText: Mixed topics and difficulties so different ages can play together.
about.audienceTeamText: Team building or a break: custom boards with inside jokes or ready-made packs.
about.audienceHostText: Control the pace on the host screen; guests or viewers join on phones.
about.rule1Text: opens tiles on the board and judges answers
about.rule2Text: enter the session on a phone, see their name and a buzz button
about.rule3Text: after a question opens, the first to buzz gets to answer
about.rule4Text: a correct answer adds the tile value; a wrong one moves play on as the host decides
about.rule5Text: play until all questions are revealed or you stop — highest score wins
about.howtoLead: The full guide lives on How to play. Short version — from the home page to the first answer:
about.packsText: The host lobby already includes packs so you don’t build a board from scratch:
about.packsMovie: films and series without the supernatural, 75 questions
about.packsMusic: hits and classics, lyrics and trivia, 75 questions
about.faq1Q: Do I need an account to play?
about.faq1A: Players join with a game code on their phone. The host creates a game from the home page — Create game.
about.faq2A: As many as fit around one screen: each player on their own phone. Bigger groups work well as teams.
about.faq3Q: Can I build my own quiz?
about.faq3A: Yes. Create a quest, set the category × question grid, add text, photos or audio — everything saves automatically.
about.faq4A: Yes. Play Quiz Quest free in the browser — no app install.
about.faq5Q: How is it different from Kahoot?
about.faq5A: It’s closer to a classic point board with buzz-in: host on the big screen, answers from phones with a show feel.
about.ctaText: Go back home and tap Create game — pick Movie Night, Hit Parade or your own quest and share the code with friends.
